scientific_validation.readme: Accepted with BF16-extraction numerical drift: all 24 displayed token IDs and selected direction position/layer agree; area maps differ by at most 0.1402% (relative-L2 <=0.02871%). The same next-speed-basin intervention gives 3.373972 versus 3.369866, with identical displayed compliance/refusal continuations and preserved basin counts.

discrete.candidate_eligibility_change: One extra non-winning candidate (position -4, layer 10): 25 eligible rather than 24. Winner remains (-5,12), with score gap 0.266 versus 0.283.

scientific_validation.conclusion: Same compliance continuation for benign input and refusal continuations for harmful/one-time-steered benign input; same low/high basin pattern. The annotated header area minimum shifts one grid cell, not to a different basin. Speed-selected steering need not coincide with an area minimum.
scientific_validation.diagnosis: Mismatch localized upstream to independently extracted BF16 direction. Exact sampled/filtered corpora, exact author source hashes, identical dependency requirements, same selected layer/position, and A100 versus H100 hardware are verified. Cross-GPU BF16 arithmetic is consistent with observed vector drift; no controlled GPU replay was run, so hardware-only causality is not claimed. Full-prefix FP64 native states match bitwise, and original plane/FD/next-basin algorithms agree by source inspection.
initial_tolerance_exceptions: Area, direction, basis and steering coefficient are not rtol=1e-5 equivalent. Scientific acceptance uses measured small error and preserved discrete selections/basins/behavior, not an assertion of FP64 rounding.
non_scientific_discrepancies: 16 unsteered NPZs store unused marker_x[1]=0 instead of historical +1. Renderer selects marker_index=0, so every displayed unsteered marker remains correct.
Row-label wording differs; omitted descriptive selection fields do not affect the renderer.
optional_faithful_fixes: If auxiliary schema parity is wanted, future generator exports should preserve fixed +1 secondary markers on unsteered rows, following context_heatmap_series.py marker_mode=fixed. Do not patch fresh NPZs.

Record extraction GPU/attention implementation/library versions in future provenance. Exact historical numerics would require a parent-approved rerun in the historical A100/BF16 stack; never substitute the old direction or hardcode the old steering coefficient.
